audit_policy.public_supported: May publish as written when the wording stays within the cited evidence ceiling.
audit_policy.private_supported: May describe at a bounded systems level; do not expose private implementation details or imply public inspectability.
audit_policy.operator_attested: Firsthand/operator fact. Preserve as operator-supplied but verify dates or externally checkable details before publication where specified.
audit_policy.caution: Wording is not false on current evidence, but can be misread as an external customer/deployment claim; preserve the narrower meaning.
audit_policy.blocked: Do not add or strengthen this claim until qualifying evidence exists.

claims.source_text: Forward-Deployed AI Architect who builds control planes for reliable, inspectable, human-directed AI workflows.

claims.source_text: work decomposition, capability-based routing, tool coordination, persistent state, provenance, verification, and bounded failure behavior

interfaces between models, runtimes, APIs, files, browsers, business tools, and human approval points
